Triage: lands in `packages/spec` (schema-free home for `pluralToSingular`, or no export at all if disposition 2 suffices) + one import line in `packages/core`; routed `pm:queue` + `domain:spec`, type Task. Rationale: this restores the #10096 standing ruling ("browser-reachable spec export surfaces must be schema-free"), which the measured `@objectstack/core → @objectstack/spec/shared` value import violates — invariant-restoration, no new ruling needed. Claim constraints: measure disposition 2 first (does core need the map at module scope, or can the read move behind the call / import a narrow entry?) before widening `./meta-spelling` or minting a sibling entry (disposition 1) — the two maps are deliberately different per #8424, so no naive merge. Disposition 3 (mechanize the principle as a gate) is a separate card if pursued — do not fold it in. Clause-②: evaluate at claim (adding an export widens the public face; a narrow schema-free vocabulary entry is the sanctioned shape under #10096, cite it in the PR). Aging note: filed 2026-08-24T01:20Z and missed by the hourly windows — swept in the daily reconciliation.
